objective: Add a reproducible, source-artifact-level StarEmbed schema and data-quality audit without claiming classifier performance or changing the frozen v0.2.0 baseline.
previous_knowledge_consumed: StarEmbed ZTF_40k is an independent source dataset with train/validation/test and anomaly splits
Raw StarEmbed-to-model inference remains unimplemented and must not be represented as completed

baseline.source_snapshot: Hugging Face revision is resolved and recorded at acquisition time

expected_improvement: Provide deterministic raw-source schema, object-overlap, array-consistency, hash, and sample diagnostics
Fail closed when source artifacts or required columns are missing
Prevent schema audit output from being misrepresented as model evaluation

evidence: Unit tests added for deterministic sample/report and missing-artifact blocking
CI on commit e08f2b44be88ec7ea2bc97f3f4d6ca7a93867808 exposed four Ruff lint violations
Lint fixes committed as bfe541b0126a77a47dc7cf9fdefb3393c1d07dd3 and 4de5b7d84008c43d71e6a5dcf764636c0823b88e
Added an isolated StarEmbed acquisition and raw schema-audit step to the existing CI test job, scoped to changes in the StarEmbed audit code, tests, manifest, or acquisition adapter/source code.
The StarEmbed step is separated from the heavy CPVS archive workflow; its real-data result remains unverified until the new CI execution completes.

validation.blocker: Lint fixes and the isolated StarEmbed CI path are committed, but no workflow result for the latest head has yet been retrieved; real StarEmbed artifact acquisition/audit and raw-data inference are not yet verified.

root_causes: Ruff RUF046 flagged redundant int casts in the new audit module
Ruff I001 flagged import ordering in the new test module
failure_analysis.impact: CI lint failed, causing downstream cumulative lifecycle, test, smoke, build, and dependency-audit jobs to be skipped.
failure_analysis.correction: Removed the reported redundant casts and sorted imports; added an isolated CI source-audit step with scope detection compatible with shallow checkouts. Await workflow evidence before declaring the fixes validated.

findings: A schema audit is not a classifier benchmark; model inference and performance evaluation remain separate blocked work.
A successful scientific-validation contract job does not imply source-backed data acquisition occurred when acquisition jobs were skipped.
CI findings must be repaired and the new commit's workflow results checked before asserting resolution.

open_blockers: Verify CI lint and full test suite after the latest workflow/code commits
Run the isolated StarEmbed acquisition and schema audit against actual source artifacts and inspect its report
Implement and independently validate raw-light-curve inference before performance claims

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not label StarEmbed schema audit as model validation
Do not change v0.2.0 baseline or weaken the fail-closed scientific gate
Keep CPVS exact-membership discrepancy as an explicit scientific validation blocker until provenance-backed root cause is established
